key_insight: GraphEP turns cardiac electrophysiology simulations into graph-native data, with physiology-informed models leading on complementary prediction metrics.
engineering_relevance: The system provides a reproducible pipeline and benchmark for learning electrical dynamics on irregular cardiac geometries.
method: Package geometry, tissue properties, stimulation, connectivity, activation targets, and provenance in PyTorch Geometric format.
Compare local message passing, global neural operators, hierarchical graph transformers, and physiology-informed models.
Separate activation timing from waveform morphology with HGT-Lag, or evolve excitation and recovery autoregressively with GAP2ODE.
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 732 left-ventricular simulations across 20 anatomies, covering healthy and scarred tissue and multiple pacing configurations.
watch_item: Generalization to patient measurements or anatomies beyond the simulated left ventricles is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: GraphEP: A Calibrated Data System and Benchmark for Learning Cardiac Electrophysiology
